manifest_role: input/code provenance and dependency boundary; generated synthetic calibration is not observational evidence

gwtc_events.csv.primary_source: Gravitational Wave Open Science Center event catalog/API
gwtc_events.csv.identifier: GWTC public event catalog export; row reference and jsonurl fields retained
gwtc_events.csv.release_version: GWTC-2.1-confident and local catalog rows (inherited canonical manifest)
gwtc_events.csv.configuration: latest version per commonName; min network SNR 8; p_astro 0.5; final mass >=5 Msun

strain.required_for: event-level matched-filter likelihood and empirical time slides

posterior_samples.required_for: event nuisance marginalization and source-frame/remnant uncertainty

noise_psd_or_time_slides.required_for: empirical background and detector-specific selection function

synthetic_calibration.background: analytic central-chi-square max-statistic null; no strain or event residuals
synthetic_calibration.injections: controlled deterministic non-central-chi-square recovery with log-normal nuisance quadrature
